'''Hunter Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] in the service of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:hunter2.jpg|thumb|left|Hunter Squadron during the [[Battle of Gwori]].]]
Hunter Squadron made a risky precision hyperspace jump to get behind the blockade enabling the fighters to make a bombing run on the shipyards. The initial wave of [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] was successful in destroying some frigates, but Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] realized that there were many more vessels and that they would not have enough bombs to be able to destroy them all. He reordered the squadron to change their targets to bring the shipyard down on itself. The attack runs were successful.
